title: Guild Ring

sources.title: Guildhall
markers: insert it into the wall slot

summary: Insert the Guild Ring into the wall slot to reveal the Guildhall entrance.

fields.Use: Insert at X 59, Y −97. The Story variant becomes the Uncommon variant when used. Both variants can open the entrance.
fields.Acquisition: Tusgront carries a ring. Two more are in locked chests inside or under Bruc and Pishe’s Emporium.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
